prompt.project_info: Misty West Lake Hanfu portrait adapted from the supplied prompt and approved-adult identity reference.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult East Asian woman with fair translucent skin, gentle eyes and natural East Asian facial contours, seated on the stone railing of the Broken Bridge of West Lake. She wears a champagne-gold Song-style beizi beneath a thin gauze large-sleeved shirt and a white pleated skirt, with naturally crossed legs, one hand lightly supporting the railing and the other holding a round fan that half covers her face.
prompt.composition_elements: Reserved gentle gaze toward the camera, misty rainy West Lake, Leifeng Pagoda and layered mountains in the distance, elegant lower-left calligraphy reading ‘Legacy Charm of Xizi’.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overcast diffused light with delicate shadow, translucent natural skin rendering, misty rain atmosphere and refined Jiangnan elegance.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical photorealistic cultural portrait, medium-long composition, realistic silk and gauze texture, subtle film grain, muted elegant tones, gentle atmospheric depth, no extra text or logos beyond the specified calligraphy.
